description: This source file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named RecentExpensesAdapter used to display a list of recent expense items, each with an amount, category, and optional note. It includes methods to submit a new list of expense items, create view holders, bind data to views, and manage the adapter's internal data set.

classes.name: RecentExpensesAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying recent expense items.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Replaces the current list of expense items and refreshes the display.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for an item view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a specific position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a single Item data object to the ViewHolder views.
